# Sol Room / Sol Conference

Sol Room is a local-first, vendor-neutral operating environment that connects humans, phones, meetings, media, existing AI voice applications and working agents through explicit audio, visual, control and artifact buses.

Current source branch:
agent/sol-room-vision-site

Current implementation phase:
Phase 0B — buildable control-plane scaffold, deterministic room/phone simulation and external OBS WebSocket proof.

Canonical read order:
1. SYSTEM_PROMPT.md
2. VISION.md
3. SOL_ROOM_MASTER_SPEC.md
4. SOUL.md
5. START_BUILD_HERE.md
6. AGENTS.md
7. CODING_AGENT_PROMPT.md
8. CODEX_PROJECT.md
9. specs/obs-plugin.md
10. lab/CURRENT_HARDWARE_TOPOLOGY.md

13. mcp/MCP_STACK.md
14. lab/USB_C_PHONE_LAB.md

Core architecture:
- Microsoft Phone Link is the first native-cellular transport adapter.
- VoiceMeeter Banana is the temporary lab audio matrix and supplies two virtual mix-minus buses.
- OBS Studio is the shared-stage compositor and operator-facing visual body.
- OBS WebSocket is used before a native OBS plugin.
- A Windows UI Automation MCP server inspects and operates Phone Link semantically.
- Sol Fabric will become the authoritative Windows media, policy and room service.
- Raspberry Pi 5 becomes the room coordinator and physical safety/control node.
- Existing ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other applications are ordinary media nodes.
- Twilio, SIP and metered realtime model APIs are optional later fallbacks only.

First no-code lab:
Phone Link + VoiceMeeter Banana + one AI voice app + OBS + scrcpy + OBS MCP + Windows UI Automation MCP.

First mix-minus buses:
- B1 feeds the AI microphone with human + caller, excluding AI output.
- B2 feeds Phone Link with human + AI, excluding caller output.

Preferred community proof tools:
- OBS control: obs-mcp 1.1.0 or sbroenne OBS MCP extension.
- Windows automation: sbroenne/mcp-windows or FlaUI-MCP.
- Android display/control: Genymobile scrcpy.
- Temporary audio routing: VoiceMeeter Banana.

Do not:
- claim Phone Link accepts a virtual microphone until tested;
- claim cellular or WhatsApp audio is captured because ordinary Android media audio works;
- rebuild Phone Link before the adapter proof;
- begin with a custom audio driver;
- begin with a native OBS plugin;
- use coordinate clicking when UI Automation or OBS APIs are available;
- expose OBS WebSocket beyond localhost during the first lab;
- commit passwords, phone numbers, transcripts, recordings or device identifiers;
- let OBS become the authoritative room-state or call-continuity process;
- start streaming, recording, calls or messages without explicit human confirmation.

Evidence standard:
A capability is verified only by an automated test, actual OS state, UI Automation snapshot, OBS state readback, audio capture, hardware diagnostic, screenshot/video or written reproducible procedure. A compilation result or successful mock is not hardware evidence.

First coding-agent objective:
Read prompts/PASTE_INTO_ANY_CODING_AGENT.txt and implement Phase 0B only. Produce a pnpm workspace, shared contracts, deterministic simulator, Sol Fabric local service, browser room console, typed OBS adapter with mock, phone adapter simulator, semantic command handlers, emergency silence, diagnostics and CI.

First human objective:
Run lab/NO_CODE_INTEGRATION_LAB.md and record the exact endpoint names and behaviour of Phone Link, VoiceMeeter, OBS and the selected MCP servers.
